hints.title: Strict Constant-Time Extrema Frequency Tracking
hints.text: Maintaining key increment and decrement operations alongside instant retrieval of minimum and maximum frequency strings requires grouping keys by frequency buckets.

hints.title: Doubly-Linked Bucket List with Key Dictionary
hints.text: Maintain an ordered doubly linked chain of bucket nodes where each node stores a distinct frequency value and a set of keys. Map each key to its corresponding bucket node.

hints.title: Bucket Migration Blueprint
hints.text: On inc(key): if key exists, move from bucket c to bucket c + 1; create bucket c + 1 if needed. Remove key from bucket c, deleting empty bucket. On dec(key): move from c to c - 1. Max key is any key in tail.prev; min key is any key in head.next.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Every operation (inc, dec, getMaxKey, getMinKey) executes in O(1) worst-case time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Tree maps or heaps incur O(log N) updates upon every increment or decrement.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Doubly-linked bucket chain guarantees O(1) adjacency updates without sorting.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Seamless cleanup of empty bucket nodes to keep head.next and tail.prev always valid.
